comments.value: Yes. Analog “RT button“ on gamepad acts as “Interact button” and SHIFT+F2. SHIFT+F2 corresponds to angry emotion. Sometimes when I select something in the room using “RT button“, the angry emotion is on and I can’t remove it. SHIFT+F1 or any key combinations has no effect. My avatar is always angry :) I have to change the avatar to another and return it again in order to reset this emotion. So the “reset button” for avatar would be useful.

It would be nice as well even if it was just in the menu to have some sort of reload Avatar Button as often sitting down in a chair while the gesture is active will make that gesture stay stuck in whatever state it was when you entered

Use Shift+F1 on overrided animation with shapekeys all set to 0. It will fix that. But if you use chair with any Gesture override(angry emote) and your avatar not have sitting animations(you use default) your emotes stuck again. Or try use any Emote from emotes menu, this action will be reset your animations.

@{5b8ae9ce77dc2133df4db0fa|full_name}: that doesnt fix gestures. The more complex avatars i make do whole animations and mesh changes on gesture, or even rigid body tracking slides off after a while, the more advanced stuff like that gets stuck sometime and a simple refresh would help. Also, vr users dont have access to keyboards while playing.

Since Main Menu 2.0 and still in build 1249 this issue has regressed, because "Change into Avatar" button is disabled when wearing it, and can't be used as a "Refresh Avatar" button. 
Refreshing the avatar is useful when uploading a new version, or when wanting to reload the avatar without resetting avatar parameters. Either the avatar change button should not be grayed out, or a separate "Refresh/Reload Avatar" button should be added. This would make sense in the new Quick Actions submenu in the Action Menu.

details: Sometimes our avatars get stuck on a gesture animation or emote animation, if possible can the "Change Avatar" button also work as a refresh button? As it is right now if you press Change Avatar to the avatar you are currently using it simply ignores the command.
title: "Refresh Avatar" Button
